About us

A local company, run by a lifetime DeLand resident

Driggers Pest Control is a fully licensed (JB199988) and insured lawn & shrub and pest control company offering both residential and commercial pest control service to customers throughout Volusia County, FL, including DeLand, DeBary, Deltona, and Orange City.

Stacy Driggers has over 23 years of experience in the lawn and shrub and pest control industry, and strives to serve his clients — and the community he grew up in — with the best service possible.
